description: Build an ROI business case from the buyer's own figures: annual_value_estimate, or current_annual_cost with expected_improvement_percent. With them it calculates the ROI, payback, three-year value and sensitivity. Without them it shows no ROI: it names the inputs to add and gives the structure of the case (the cost lines to price, your quoted results as reference points, the questions to ask).

annual_revenue.description: Customer annual revenue. Shown as your input; it is not turned into a value

annual_value_estimate.description: Optional: the buyer's own estimate of the annual value in dollars; used as the value when given

current_annual_cost.description: Optional: what the problem or the current process costs the buyer a year, in dollars (their figure)

current_process.description: How they do it today. Separate the ways of working with a semicolon: each becomes a cost line to price. Not used in the calculation

employee_count.description: Number of employees. Shown as your input; it is not turned into a value

expected_improvement_percent.description: Optional: the share of that annual cost the buyer expects to save, in percent (their figure)

implementation_timeline.description: Expected implementation time. Shown in the output; not used in the calculation

industry.description: The customer's industry, in any words. Used for wording and sector notes only: no industry figure is applied to the calculation. A return needs the buyer's own figures (annual_value_estimate, or current_annual_cost with expected_improvement_percent)

known_metrics.description: Metrics the prospect shared, or results you can quote. Listed as reference points, never as the buyer's figures; to turn the buyer's figures into the value, give current_annual_cost and expected_improvement_percent, or annual_value_estimate

your_sector.description: Optional: your company's own industry (not your customers'). When given, it decides the sector notes; when left out, the tool reads it from your words and stays neutral if they are unclear.

name: roi_business_case_builder
title: ROI Business Case Builder
